industriesPage.title: Built for every field
industriesPage.lead: MISVOR works wherever people repeat steps that software can learn. Pick your sector to see what we automate.

aiAgents.title: AI agents
aiAgents.short: Assistants that read, decide and act inside the tools your team already uses.
aiAgents.lead: Agents that answer customers, triage requests and carry out tasks, with a human in the loop wherever it matters.
aiAgents.overview: An agent is more than a chatbot. It understands a request, looks things up in your systems, takes the next step and hands over to a person when it should. We build agents on your data, with clear limits on what they may do, and we measure them like any other part of your team.
build: Customer and staff assistants on web, email and WhatsApp
Request triage that routes work to the right person
Agents that act in your CRM, ERP and ticketing tools
Evaluation and guardrails so answers stay accurate and on policy
steps: We pick one repetitive conversation or task and define what a good result looks like.
We build the agent on your documents and systems, then test it against real examples.
It goes live with logging, review queues and a simple way to correct it.
aiAgents.outcome: Routine requests answered in seconds, and people free for the work that needs them.

workflowAutomation.title: Workflow automation
workflowAutomation.short: Processes that move forward on their own, from trigger to finished task.
workflowAutomation.lead: Invoices, onboarding, approvals and reports that run without anyone chasing them.
workflowAutomation.overview: Most companies run on a web of emails, spreadsheets and reminders. We map that web, connect your systems and automate the steps in between, with alerts when something needs a human. Every workflow is monitored and documented, so it keeps working after we leave.
build: Integrations between the tools you already pay for
Approval flows, reminders and status updates
Scheduled reports and data syncs
Monitoring, retries and clear alerts when a step fails
steps: We map how the work really flows today, including the exceptions.
We automate the repeatable path and design a clean route for exceptions.
We monitor the workflow and tune it as your process changes.
workflowAutomation.outcome: Fewer handoffs, fewer errors and work that no longer waits for someone to remember.

documentIntelligence.title: Document intelligence
documentIntelligence.short: Invoices, contracts and forms read, checked and filed automatically.
documentIntelligence.lead: Turn piles of PDFs, scans and emails into structured data your systems can use.
documentIntelligence.overview: Documents are where manual work hides. We build pipelines that read incoming files, extract the fields that matter, check them against your rules and file them in the right place. They can run on your own servers, so sensitive documents never leave your control.
build: Reading of invoices, bills of lading, payslips and contracts
Validation against your rules, with exceptions sent to a person
Search across your archive in plain language
Private deployment on your own infrastructure
steps: We collect a sample of your real documents, including the messy ones.
We tune extraction and validation until the results match your checks.
Documents flow in, data flows out, and exceptions land in a review queue.
documentIntelligence.outcome: Hours of typing replaced by a review queue that takes minutes.

dataAnalytics.title: Data and analytics
dataAnalytics.short: Clean pipelines and live dashboards that give you one version of the truth.
dataAnalytics.lead: Bring scattered spreadsheets and systems together, then see what is really happening.
dataAnalytics.overview: Good decisions need numbers you can trust. We build the pipelines that collect and clean your data, the models that find patterns in it and the dashboards that put it in front of the right people. Forecasts come only when the data supports them.
build: Data pipelines with cleaning and quality checks
Dashboards for finance, operations and sales
Forecasting and anomaly detection where the data allows
Reports that arrive on schedule without anyone building them
steps: We list the questions you need answered and where the data lives.
We connect and clean the sources, and agree on one definition for each number.
Dashboards and alerts go live, and we keep refining them with your team.
dataAnalytics.outcome: One source of truth that everyone reads from.

cloudDevops.title: Cloud and DevOps
cloudDevops.short: Reliable, scalable infrastructure that your automation can stand on.
cloudDevops.lead: Cloud foundations, pipelines and monitoring built for uptime and sensible cost.
cloudDevops.overview: Automation is only as dependable as what it runs on. We design cloud infrastructure as code, automate your releases and set up monitoring that tells you about problems before your users do. We work across AWS and Google Cloud, with Kubernetes where it earns its place.
build: Infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible
CI/CD pipelines that ship safely and often
Containers and Kubernetes where they fit
Monitoring, alerting and cost control
steps: We review what you run today and where it is fragile or expensive.
We rebuild the foundations as code and automate builds, tests and releases.
We watch the system, respond to alerts and keep costs in check.
cloudDevops.outcome: Systems that stay up, release without drama and cost what they should.

securityCompliance.title: Security and compliance
securityCompliance.short: Access control, protection and audit trails built in from the first day.
securityCompliance.lead: Automation that satisfies your security team and your regulators.
securityCompliance.overview: Every automation touches data, so security has to be part of the design. We apply least-privilege access, strong authentication, encryption and testing from the start, and prepare the evidence you need for GDPR and ISO 27001 style audits.
build: Identity and access management with least privilege and MFA
Security testing and code scanning in your pipelines
Encrypted storage, backups and recovery plans
Policies and evidence for GDPR and ISO 27001
steps: We map what data you hold, who touches it and where the risks are.
We close the gaps with access controls, encryption and automated checks.
We keep testing and reporting so compliance stays current.
securityCompliance.outcome: Automation your security team can approve and your auditors can trace.

finance.title: Finance, accounting and legal
finance.short: Close faster and keep every document under control.
finance.lead: Automation for teams that handle money, contracts and deadlines.
finance.overview: Finance and legal work runs on documents, rules and deadlines, which is exactly where automation pays back. We read and post invoices, reconcile accounts, track obligations and answer routine questions, all with the audit trail these teams need.
automate: Invoice and receipt capture with automatic posting
finance.example: A supplier invoice arrives by email, the agent reads it, matches it to the purchase order, posts it to the ledger and asks a person only when something does not match.

healthcare.title: Healthcare
healthcare.short: Less paperwork between clinicians and patients.
healthcare.lead: Automation that gives care teams their time back while keeping patient data private.
healthcare.overview: Clinics and health companies lose hours to forms, scheduling and records. We automate the administrative load around care, with strict access control and private deployment so sensitive data stays where it belongs.
automate: Intake forms and referral letters read into records
healthcare.example: A patient messages to rebook, the assistant offers open slots, confirms the change, updates the schedule and sends a reminder the day before.

logistics.title: Logistics and freight
logistics.short: Shipping documents handled in minutes, not hours.
logistics.lead: From bills of lading to delivery updates, automation for the paperwork that moves goods.
logistics.overview: Freight runs on documents in dozens of formats and languages. We build pipelines that read them, check them and feed your systems, and workflows that keep customers informed without a call centre.
automate: Reading of bills of lading, invoices and customs forms
Shipment tracking and customer status updates
Exception alerts for delays and mismatches
logistics.example: A bill of lading lands in the shared inbox, the pipeline extracts the consignee, weights and references, checks them against the booking and flags only the differences.

retail.title: Retail and e-commerce
retail.short: Stores that run smoothly behind the scenes.
retail.lead: Automation for catalogues, orders and customer service across your sales channels.
retail.overview: Online shops juggle products, stock, orders and questions every day. We automate testing, catalogue updates, order handling and support, across platforms such as Shopify and Shopware, so launches and campaigns do not break anything.
automate: Catalogue and price updates across channels
Order routing, returns and customer messages
Automated testing of storefronts before every release
retail.example: A customer asks where their order is, the assistant checks the carrier, answers in their language and opens a ticket only if the parcel is late.

media.title: Media and publishing
media.short: Publish faster and reach readers with the right story.
media.lead: Automation for newsrooms, creators and content teams.
media.overview: Content teams spend their days on formatting, distribution and follow-ups. We automate the pipeline from draft to publication, personalise what each reader sees and handle notifications, so editors can focus on the story.
automate: Publishing workflows across web, email and social
media.example: A story is approved, the workflow publishes it, creates summaries in three languages and sends push notifications to the readers who follow that topic.

education.title: Education
education.lead: Automation and assistants for schools, universities and training providers.
education.overview: Educators lose time to enrolment, timetabling and repeated student questions. We build assistants and workflows that handle the routine, plus dashboards that show where students need support.
automate: Student and staff assistants for common questions
Lab and course environments set up automatically
education.example: A student asks about deadlines, the assistant answers from the course handbook, and sends the request to staff if it needs a decision.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing and energy
manufacturing.short: Connect the factory floor to the office.
manufacturing.lead: Automation for operations, maintenance and reporting in industrial settings.
manufacturing.overview: Plants produce data all day, but it rarely reaches the people who can act on it. We connect machines, systems and teams, automate reports and maintenance requests, and build infrastructure that stays up around the clock.
automate: Alerts when readings drift out of range
manufacturing.example: A sensor reading drifts, the workflow opens a maintenance ticket, notifies the shift lead and orders the part if stock is low.

professional.title: Professional services
professional.short: Firms and agencies that deliver more with the same team.
professional.lead: Automation for consultants, agencies, advisors and small firms.
professional.overview: Service firms sell expertise, yet lose hours to onboarding, reporting and chasing clients. We automate those tasks, add assistants that prepare answers for your people and keep client documents organised and secure.
automate: Drafting assistants that prepare first versions
professional.example: A new client signs, the workflow creates their folder, sends the document checklist, tracks what is missing and reminds them until it is complete.

aboutPage.title: A technology company for every kind of work
aboutPage.lead: MISVOR builds the AI and automation that lets organisations in any field spend their time on what matters.
aboutPage.story1: Every industry has the same hidden problem. Skilled people spend their days on repetitive steps, copying data between systems, chasing approvals and reading the same documents again and again. Software can take that on, if it is built around how the work really happens.
aboutPage.story2: MISVOR is based in Valencia and works with teams around the world. We combine AI, automation and solid engineering, so what we deliver is secure, documented and ready for your team to own.
aboutPage.whereBody: The founder has delivered projects from these cities. We work in English and French, with Spanish and Japanese also spoken.

useful.title: Useful before clever
useful.body: We start with the task that costs you the most time and choose the simplest tool that solves it.

yours.title: Your data stays yours
yours.body: Systems can run on your own infrastructure, and access is limited to what each person needs.

human.title: People stay in the loop
human.body: Agents ask for help when they are unsure, and every important action can be reviewed.

handover.title: Built to be handed over
handover.body: Everything is documented and tested, so your team can run it without us.

founderPage.title: Meet the founder
founderPage.lead: Elad Anedo Daudet Ikeorah builds secure, automated systems for teams across four continents.
founderPage.name: Elad Anedo Daudet Ikeorah
founderPage.heading: An engineer who has run the systems he builds
founderPage.body1: Elad has spent more than six years building secure, automated systems for teams in Cameroon, Germany, Japan, India, Spain and the United States. His work spans DevOps, cloud infrastructure, security operations, data engineering and AI automation.
founderPage.body2: That mix matters. An AI agent is only useful when it runs on reliable infrastructure, handles data safely and fits the way people work. He designs all three together, and works in English and French, with Spanish and Japanese also spoken.

faq.q: Can we start with something small?
faq.a: Yes. Most clients begin with a pilot on one process, then expand once the results are clear.

faq.q: Who owns the systems you build?
faq.a: You do. We document everything and hand over the code, configuration and access, so you are never locked in.

faq.q: Can it run on our own servers?
faq.a: Yes. We can deploy in your cloud account or on your own infrastructure, which is often the right choice for sensitive documents.

faq.q: How long does a pilot take?
faq.a: It depends on the process, but we aim for a working prototype early enough that you can judge it on real data and change direction if needed.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.lead: Straight answers about how we work.

items.a: We design, build and run AI agents and automation workflows for organisations in any field, together with the cloud, data and security work they depend on.

items.q: Do we need to be a technology company to work with you?
items.a: No. Most of our clients are not. We work with teams in finance, healthcare, logistics, retail, media, education and more, and we explain things in plain language.
Wherever you decide. We can run everything inside your own cloud account or servers, and models can be hosted privately when documents are sensitive.
Sometimes, which is why we design for it. Agents work within clear limits, log what they do and pass uncertain cases to a person.
We choose what fits, often n8n, Python, LangChain, PostgreSQL and the main clouds. We work with the systems you already have.

items.q: How do you handle security and GDPR?
items.a: Access is limited to what each person needs, data is encrypted, and we prepare the documentation you need for GDPR and ISO 27001 style reviews.

items.q: Can you support us after launch?
items.a: Yes. Many clients keep us on a monthly plan to monitor, tune and extend what we built.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: English and French day to day, with Spanish and Japanese also spoken.
Send us a short description of the process you want to improve. We reply with questions and a proposal for a pilot.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How we handle your personal data.

sections.p: MISVOR, based in {location}, is responsible for the data collected on this site. Contact: {email}.
Only what you send us: the details in the contact form, your email if you subscribe to the newsletter and the notification preferences you choose.
To answer your enquiry, to send the newsletter you asked for and to keep the site secure. We do not sell your data.
We use service providers such as email delivery and hosting services, who process data on our behalf under appropriate agreements.
Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to handle them and for a reasonable period afterwards. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.
You can ask us to access, correct, delete or export your data, and to restrict or object to its use. Write to {email}. You may also complain to your data protection authority.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: What this site stores in your browser.

sections.p: This site uses only the cookies it needs to work, such as the one that remembers your language and the session cookie for staff who sign in. It does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the language cookie, the site will ask again on your next visit.
If we add analytics or other optional cookies, we will ask for your consent first and update this page.

terms.title: General terms
terms.lead: The rules for using this website.

sections.p: You may use this site for lawful purposes. Please do not attempt to disrupt it, access areas that are not public or misuse its forms.
Articles and pages describe our services and ideas in general terms. They are not professional advice for your specific situation.
Work for clients is governed by a separate written agreement or quote that sets out scope, price and responsibilities.
We may update the site and these terms from time to time. The date at the bottom shows the latest version.

misvorAi.title: Say hello to MISVOR AI
misvorAi.body: Describe a task in plain words, such as chasing invoices or sorting customer emails, and MISVOR AI helps you shape it into an agent or a workflow.
